title: Invoicing with a tax-rate cache that outlives the objects using it
name: Invoice tax policy

questions.prompt: After we onboarded the EU entity, invoices for the same region code come out with the wrong tax depending on which entity's service handled the first invoice since the last restart. The two entities each configure their own rate table. A rate table swap in the admin tool is also ignored until the process restarts. Fix TaxPolicy.java so the tests pass.
